_meta.generator: gen_genesis_reseat_v1.py over gen_genesis_bundles_v2.py's machinery (independent of verify)
_meta.keys: As genesis_bundles_v2.json, plus S1N = Key 13 (S1's new key) and U = Key 14 (a key unrelated to S1). Key n: ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 seed [n+100]*32.

cases.description: v2's first_valid: three holders, two seats, every holder signed, thumbprint anchor.

A later bundle every holder signs re-seats S1 at a new key S1N. S1's new key record and its binding are authored with iss = author = S1's identity reference and signed by S1N; the binding names the new record. S1 is placed at S1N's key, record, binding and X-Wing keys.
The same bundle, with S1's binding signed by S1's previous key while the record the bundle places for S1 names S1N: the binding does not verify under the key placed for the seat.
The same bundle, with S1's binding (iss S1) signed by a key U unrelated to S1: the binding does not verify under the key placed for the seat.
